title: Punjab Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1993

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1993
ACT III OF 1993
PUNJAB MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1993
An Act further to amend the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 27th February, 1993]
No. Legis.2(4)/91/86, dated
27-2-1993.--The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
(Amendment) Bill, 1991, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on the 17th day of February, 1993 and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on the 23rd day of February, 1993, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1993.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Amendment of section 8 of Act XLI of 1975

ACT III OF 1993
ACT III OF 1993
PUNJAB MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1993
An Act further to amend the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 27th February, 1993]
No. Legis.2(4)/91/86, dated
27-2-1993.--The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
(Amendment) Bill, 1991, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on the 17th day of February, 1993 and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on the 23rd day of February, 1993, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
2. Amendment of section 8 of Act XLI of 1975.-- In the Punjab
Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (XLI of 1975), in
section 8 for the words "eight thousand" wherever occurring, the
words "fifteen thousand" shall be substituted.
